source.name: World Air Quality Index project (WAQI)
source.note: Advisory only, never a gate: a different scale on a different pipeline cannot detect a factor-of-two error. Used to ask whether an independent network sees the same pollutant worst at a station whose reading rests on one channel.

guard.why: WAQI always returns a station. For Leh it returns Ngari, Tibet, 330km away; by name it returns Le Havre, France. Unguarded, either would have settled the question with a monitor that has never seen the place.
